pillars.name: 1 · The Mohs Surgeon Explains
pillars.why: Skin-cancer awareness 4.1× outlier overall, 31.3× and 53% winners on TikTok; Mohs-tagged videos 20.8× but only 9 exist. Only a triple-board-certified Mohs surgeon can own it. Weekly, Mondays.

pillars.name: 2 · Proof, Narrated
pillars.why: Before-after 10.2× (47% win) and voiceover-over-procedure 2.85×, but 1.0% engagement. His voice over the footage adds the trust the genre lacks. His own Botox before/after did 522K.

pillars.name: 3 · Myth-Bust & Red Flags
pillars.why: Myth-bust 1.32× and the only genre above median on reach, engagement (3.4%), saves (0.63%) and comments. His best 2026 reel is a red-flag case (61K).

pillars.name: 4 · Your Questions, Answered
pillars.why: Q&A / comment-reply has the highest save (0.66%) and comment (0.14%) rates; 47 real viewer questions are waiting. Phone, one take.

pillars.name: 5 · Trend, Checked by a Surgeon
pillars.why: Ozempic face 752K median, baby botox 11.1×, buccal fat 2.9×; PDRN and salmon sperm are carried by gossip pages with no credentialed voice. At most once a week.

slots.title: Melanoma or not? A Mohs surgeon plays along
slots.angle: Four real lesion photos on screen, one at a time; viewers guess, he answers with the one feature that decided it (ABCDE, the 'ugly duckling'). The quiz format is the biggest thing in this lane; the payoff is that viewers learn the rule, not just the answer.

refs.why: Melanoma-or-not quiz: 12.6M views, 106× the creator's norm
"Early skin cancer can look very subtle": 1.0M, 62×
Skin-cancer awareness explainer with a derm: 9.6M, 115×

slots.ostad_version: He's examined skin under the microscope for 25 years and has the Skin Cancer Foundation seat; he can say what the pathology slide showed after each guess. Use consented patient photos from his own files, not stock.

slots.title: What 1 round of Fraxel does to acne scars (day 0 → day 30)
slots.angle: Open on the result, then rewind through day 0, day 3 (the sandpaper phase) and day 30, with his voice on what's happening under the skin at each step. Acne scars are 5.9× with 52% winners; the reveal does the reach and the narration does the trust.

refs.why: Patient's Fraxel results for scars and pores: 2.0M, 232×
CO2 diary with an honest downtime reveal: 1.0M, 201×
"CO2 laser: is it worth it?" with results: 708K, 445×

slots.ostad_version: He narrates as the surgeon (depth settings, why one pass vs two) rather than a patient diary. End on his 'less is more' line: one well-chosen treatment beats five trendy ones.

slots.title: No, you don't skip sunscreen because you use a retinoid. It's the opposite.
slots.angle: Answers the 1,789-like comment directly: retinoids thin the outer layer and raise sun sensitivity, so SPF matters more, not less. Three short rules, no product list. Sunscreen content averages 0.56×; the contrarian framing is what lifts it.

refs.why: "I will die on this hill" contrarian open: 2.8M, 9.5% engagement
